name: Amoralist (Legendary Druid Archetype)
body:
The legendary druid’s first allegiance is to the force of nature, not any ethos and certainly not to any deity. A legendary druid does not worship any god and does not ascribe to their notions of good and evil.

Kindness and Cruelty (Ex)

Nature can be kind, cruel, predictable, or spontaneous. The legendary druid is similarly beyond simple understanding of good and evil. Although a legendary druid possesses an alignment, whenever they regain their spell slots, they may permanently change their alignment to any other neutral alignment. The change is permanent until they change it again.

If the legendary druid casts a spell with the chaotic, evil, good, or lawful descriptor, their alignment changes to the corresponding neutral alignment.

This modifies alignment.

Druidic Talents

The following talents are available to amoralist legendary druids:

Aligned Kinship (Minor Talent) (Ex)

Creatures you summon have the celestial, entropic, fiendish, or resolute template, depending on your current alignment, and their attacks have the appropriate alignment descriptor for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

If you possess an animal companion, familiar, or mount, the template applies to them as well.

Aligned Protection (Minor Talent) (Su)

You are under the protection of a continual protection from chaos/evil/good/law against the alignment that is opposite your current alignment.

Aligned Skill (Minor Talent) (Ex)

Depending on their current alignment, the legendary druid gains a focus skill that they are more capable of. When using this skill, they gain a competence bonus equal to half their class level.

Alignment Focus	Skill
Chaotic	Bluff
Evil	Intimidate
Good	Handle Animal
Lawful	Diplomacy
